PLAN "12-Week Strength Return to Skiing"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "restore lower-body strength safely for skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation and Tissue Tolerance" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 4x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Lower Body Strength B":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          step_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
